scope: One short nonfracturing prescribed-translation test on the qualified intact FEM, exact original blade CAD. Not prepared-cut assembly, native Isaac robot/mounted feedback, cutting or separation qualification.
gate: Full1s corrected-law finite-board hold AND half-step comparison must pass first. Exact CAD geometry/wrench, legacy force functional form and coupled implicit-normal-dashpot controls must pass.
shape_and_force: 74 original CAD vertices/144 triangles unchanged; saved CAD orientation retained through checked proper frame transform. Exterior-node collocation is a disclosed new quadrature adapter, not virtual-edge/contact-integral equivalence. Source surface ke2000,kd1,kf2500,mu.5 and mu_static.5. kf is the source Brown-law velocity scale, not the board's viscous coefficient. No parameter fit or friction disabling.
integration: Bulk viscosity, board friction and unilateral blade normal dashpot implicit in one mass-scaled Newton solve. Blade elastic penalty and weak Brown friction at old geometry/velocity; no blade angular motion. Select dt<=qualified7.4626866e-6 AND .5sqrt(minimum potentially-contacting nodal mass/2000), then compare one half-step run.
motion: Static exact-CAD signed-distance placement with5micrometre initial nodal clearance;15micrometre downward approach over15ms, then horizontal withdrawal along existing bodyward direction over20ms until static15micrometre clearance;10ms unloaded observation. Quintic ramps with zero endpoint velocities. No upward withdrawal. No damage or interface release.

acceptance.classification: same loaded/unloaded and finite/cell/support outcomes; fracture disabled in both; no separation equivalence inferred
acceptance.measurement: Contact-law reaction and moment recomputed at common sampled q,v,tool pose. Solver-applied interval forces separately audited against measured discrete momentum; do not call either channel actual native motor effort.

limits: No claim of collision completeness between exterior nodes; surface/force resolution dependence remains for later cutting qualification. New conforming cut mesh's sliver cells and cohesive-assembly stability remain separate open prerequisites for a shallow cut.
